summary: Reader::reset left output_pos unchanged after reading a partial record, causing subsequent field-end positions to include stale output bytes. The upstream regression test reads a partial "baz", resets, then parses "baz,raz\n"; the buggy implementation reports ends[0] as 6 instead of 3. Resetting output_pos to zero corrects these offsets. The proposed reversal removes only that assignment. Tests were not executed.
